A dependency-only release. No tool was added or removed — the server still
declares 110 — and no server code changed. The bundle is rebuilt with the
dependencies updated by the security advisories published since v4.6.0, so
what you download carries the patched versions.

## Security patches

All of these are transitive dependencies of the MCP SDK or of axios; none is
imported by the server itself.

- **proxy-addr** 2.0.7 → 2.0.8 (critical) — IP spoofing through an
  IPv4-mapped IPv6 address matching a trusted subnet.
- **zod** 4.4.3 → 4.6.7 (high) — memory exhaustion while validating
  oversized constrained collections (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5).
- **body-parser** 2.3.0 → 2.4.0 (high) — denial of service through trailing
  bytes after a compressed request body. Override raised to `>=2.4.0`.
- **follow-redirects** 1.16.0 → 1.16.2 (high) — three ways credential headers
  could survive a cross-origin redirect: array-form headers, regex escaping of
  `sensitiveHeaders`, and cross-realm `sensitiveHeaders` arrays. Override
  raised to `>=1.16.2`.
- **hono** 4.13.7 → 4.13.18 — `serveStatic` double decoding that bypassed
  path middleware; `csrf()` ignoring `text/ping` requests; `validator('form')`
  skipping multipart bodies with extra parameters; `mount()` forwarding paths
  around scoped middleware; RegExpRouter skipping wildcard middleware; HTML
  injection in the `css` helper.
- **@hono/node-server** 2.0.11 → 2.1.8 — `serveStatic` double decoding,
  backslashes parsed as path separators, and a process crash on `ECONNRESET`
  during a WebSocket upgrade.
- **fast-uri** 4.1.4 → 4.2.3 — eight advisories on host confusion, scheme
  spoofing and injection, path equivalence and `mailto` header injection.
  Override raised to `>=4.2.3`.
- **ip-address** 10.5.0 → 10.7.5 — SSRF and trust-boundary bypasses (NAT64
  local-use range, `fe80::/10` link-local, mixed-family subnet checks) and
  two inputs that stall the process.

## Version updates

- **@modelcontextprotocol/sdk** 1.30.0 → 1.32.2, **axios** 1.20.0 → 1.21.1,
  **dotenv** 18.0.0 → 18.0.10, plus express-rate-limit, iconv-lite and qs as
  they come along. No API used by the server changed.
- Development only, not shipped in the bundle: @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm
  6 → 7 (its JSON validator is now an explicit dev dependency), @types/node
  and tsx; zod 4 is forced under `@anthropic-ai/mcpb`, whose latest release
  still pins zod 3. The node-forge, glob and minimatch advisories reported in
  the toolchain are fixed too.

`npm audit` on this release reports no vulnerabilities.

## Install

Download `garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb` and open it with Claude Desktop, or drag it onto
Settings → Extensions. Verify the download first:

```
sha256sum -c garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb.sha256
```

The CycloneDX inventory of the bundle is attached as
`garmin-mcp-ts.sbom.cdx.json`.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/sedoglia/garmin-mcp-ts/compare/v4.6.0...v4.6.1
